failClosedRules: NO_EVENT or evidenceReady alone does not authorize CLEAR_NO_ACTION

After canonical S22-T06~T10 fingerprints, execute the read-only/artifact-only NC-T01 S22-T11~T16.

Verify full candidate-universe provenance is preserved.
Verify exact source/window/decision hash binding and no System1 fallback.
Only then credit the first physical NC-T01 witness.
